control.description-key: Virtual PCF: attachment list for sprk_communication. Replaces the OOB attachment subgrid — lists the communication's sprk_communicationattachment rows (name + type; inline-image types filtered out) and on row click opens the shared RichFilePreviewDialog for that attachment's sprk_document (preview URL via BFF; .eml/message-rfc822 routes to download/open). Auth via @spaarke/auth (ADR-028). Place in the OOB form where the attachment subgrid was.

property.name: boundField
property.description-key: Bind to any text column on the form (e.g. sprk_name). Used only as a placement anchor; the control reads the communication id from page context and queries attachments via the Web API.

property.name: apiBaseUrl
property.description-key: BFF API base URL. When empty, resolved from the Dataverse environment variable sprk_BffApiBaseUrl.

property.name: tenantId
property.description-key: Azure AD tenant ID. When empty, resolved from the Dataverse environment variable sprk_TenantId.

property.name: clientAppId
property.description-key: Azure AD application (client) ID for PCF MSAL authentication. When empty, resolved from the Dataverse environment variable sprk_MsalClientId.

property.name: bffAppId
property.description-key: BFF API application ID for OAuth scope construction. When empty, resolved from the Dataverse environment variable sprk_BffApiAppId.

property.name: showVersionFooter
property.description-key: When true (default), displays the PCF version footer at the bottom of the control. Set to false to hide it on production forms.
